verses.text: The LORD reigns! He wears majesty like a robe and straps on strength. The world is firmly in place. Nothing can move it.
Your throne has stood since long ago. You’ve been here from everlasting.
The floods have risen, LORD. The floods have raised their roar. The floods lift their waves.
Louder than the roar of mighty waters, stronger than the crashing waves of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
Your laws stand firm. Holiness makes your house beautiful, LORD, forever.
